intervention: Only the common measurement region changes: project each point or sampled curve point into raw observed/unambiguous RGB edge pairs. Require three distinct views; horizontal 1px quantization allowance; nearest original row without vertical dilation. Unknown, absent and ambiguous rows contribute no support. No fitted 3D axis, candidate IDs, truth or inferred rod width enters this region.
paired_policy: Use the exact same complete immutable base and saved patches as the parent, no point suppression, no candidate-specific mask. Cache the same base-point mask for every method. Readout, two old grid scales and physical metrics remain unchanged. Both broad-strip and supported results are retained.
freeze_policy: Freeze sources and expected 18 readout rows before either new point-patch or supported-readout physical evaluation. Design may inspect normal outputs and RGB only. Known-answer controls cover off-axis, behind-camera, gaps, unknown/ambiguous rows, duplicate views and point/segment representation equivalence.
qualification: Conditional measurement diagnostic on known synthetic development cases, not general reader qualification or automatic foreground identity. A painted line with identical multi-view support remains photometrically indistinguishable. Not a G1 pass.
